What it does: Random spooks per minute for a horse with average Nerves, in daylight, walking, at bond 2-3. Multiplied by the player's SpookFrequency.
Each point of Nerves multiplies the random spook rate by e^slope: 0.55 makes Nerves +2 three times as jumpy as average, -2 a third.
Random spook rate at night.
Game hour (0-23) when night starts.
Game hour (0-23) when night ends.
Random spook rate at a gallop.
Speed in m/s that counts as a gallop.
Random spook rate at bond level 1 or below.
Random spook rate at bond level 4.
Chance an average-Courage horse spooks at a nearby predator or gunshot.
How fast that chance falls with Courage: 1.1 gives about 90% at Courage -2 and 10% at +2.
Metres within which a predator counts as a threat.
Your own shots count this much of a stranger's: horses are used to their rider.
An explosion is judged as if the horse had this much less Courage.
Chance an average-Temper horse bucks or refuses when pushed (spurred at low stamina, a long sprint, a hard stop).
Each point of Temper multiplies that chance by e^slope: Temper +2 is about 7 times average.
The push buck chance never goes above this.
Stamina core (0-100) below which spurring counts as pushing.
Sprinting this long counts as pushing.
Losing this many m/s in one second from a gallop counts as a hard stop or turn.
A scared horse you're riding with Temper at or above this throws you instead of rearing.
A scared or spooked horse you're riding with Courage below this rears; above it, it only gets agitated.
A scared horse you're not riding with Courage below this bolts; above it, it watches the threat.
Chance an average-Temper horse kicks you after you stand behind it (Temper slope applies).
How long you stand behind it before it may kick.
Metres behind the horse that count as behind it.
Each point of Bond affinity multiplies bond XP by e^slope: +2 about 1.5 times, -2 about 0.67.
Bond XP rate for a wild horse that broke Hard.
Extra times a Hard wild horse throws you before it can break.
Seconds into breaking before a Hard horse's extra throw.
Seconds into breaking before an Unbreakable horse always throws you.
Seconds between two spooks of one horse.
Seconds between two bucks or refusals.
Seconds between two kicks.
Seconds between small tells (a snort, a look at a threat).
Shortest gap between any two behaviors of one horse.
A horse judges a threat once: each predator when it comes in range, gunfire once per gunfight. The gunfight is over after this many quiet seconds.
Below this speed (m/s) a horse counts as standing still (Head-tosser, Kicker, Wanderer, impatience).
Chatterbox: calls or snorts per minute.
Chatterbox: rate multiplier when another horse is within the Nosy range.
Head-tosser: restless head tosses per minute while standing still.
Nosy: looks per minute while people or animals are within range.
Nosy: metres within which it turns to watch people and animals.
Shadow: follows when you walk this many metres away from it.
Shadow: how long it follows you.
Wanderer: seconds standing with you away before it wanders off.
Wanderer: you must be at least this far away (m).
Wanderer: how long it wanders before grazing.
Wanderer: how long it grazes.
Kicker: chance per check to kick an NPC standing right behind it (Kick behind distance).
Kicker: kicks only with no other people within this range (m), so no crime is seen.
Care reactions start this long after the vanilla pat, brush or feed animation ends.
Bond affinity at or above this (and Temper below it): affectionate. Temper at or above: grumpy. Bond affinity at or below minus this: aloof.
Chance of a care reaction at bond 1.
Each bond level above 1 lowers the reaction chance by this share (bond 4: 40% less).
Picky eater: share of treats it loves (by its seed and the item).
Picky eater: share of treats it ignores; the rest are ordinary.
Demeanor Impatient: starts fidgeting after standing this long with you nearby.
Demeanor Impatient: fidgets per minute per point of Impatient.
Demeanor Alert: looks around per minute per point of Alert.
Demeanor Fussy: dirtiness rank at or above which it is unhappy (guess: Phase 7 checks the scale).
Demeanor Fussy: unhappy snorts per minute per point of Fussy while dirty.
Each point of a breed's Affectionate demeanor adds this to Bond affinity when choosing its care reaction style (drafts lean into pats).
Snake drama: snakes count as threats from this many times Predator range.
Moody refusal: refusals per minute while ridden at a walk (1.5 times at bond 1).
Below this speed (m/s), and above Standing still speed, a ridden horse is walking.
Night owl: random spook rate at night is multiplied by this instead of the night multiplier.
City lover: random spook rate in towns.
Town disdain: snorts and stares per minute in a town with people close.
Town disdain: people within this range (m) get the attitude.
Dramatic rear: chance to rear when you start aiming while it stands still at dusk or night.
Game hour from which it is dusk (Dramatic rear), until Night ends hour.
Escape artist: seconds standing hitched with you away before it unhitches itself.
Escape artist: you must be at least this far away (m).
Prankster: throws per minute while you sit still on it near people in combat with you (before you've fired).
Prankster: enemies within this range (m) count.
Lazy pace: the most it will move without spurring (move blend ratio: 1 walk, 2 trot, 3 run).
Roadside grazer: seconds standing still with you on it before it lowers its head to graze.
Roadside grazer: how long it grazes.
Hill sigh: climbing faster than this (m/s upward) at a walk counts as a steep hill.
Hill sigh: sighs per minute on a steep climb.
Scatterbrain: sudden skids per minute at a gallop, without fear.
Soul stare: a stranger closer than this (m) gets stared at.
Soul stare: how long the stare lasts.
Soul stare: stares per minute while a stranger is close.
Wolf brawler: how long it fights a predator before the task is cleared.
Camp creeper: NPCs within this range (m) may get crept up on.
Camp creeper: creeps per minute while you're near and an NPC is in range.
Camp creeper: how long it follows the NPC.
Brush excitement: chance it gets excited as soon as you start brushing.
Shortest gap (s) between two coat signature habits on one horse (they also respect the 20 s Behavior gap).
Wanderlust: seconds standing untied with you away before it sets off.
Wanderlust: you must be at least this far away (m).
Wanderlust: how long it roams before it stops (whistle it back sooner).
Bored buck: seconds of aiming from its back, standing still, before it gets bored.
Bored buck: chance per aim. Bond 1-2 throws you; bond 3-4 only fidgets.
Clumsy: trips (skids) per minute at a trot or canter.
Snack magnet: stops to graze per minute at a walk.
Snack magnet: how long it grazes before you can move on.
Short king: another horse within this range (m) gets squared up to.
Short king: stand-offs per minute while another horse is close.
Selective hearing: chance it ignores your whistle at first.
Selective hearing: how long it ignores you before it comes.
Saddle hater: chance it nips and tosses its head as you get on.
Bounty stomper: a hogtied person within this range (m) gets stamped at.
Bounty stomper: stamps per minute (never a real trample).
Guard dog: strangers within this range (m) of the horse get stomped at.
Guard dog: stomps per minute while a stranger is close and you're off it.
Unhurried: the pace cap when you spur without danger (move blend ratio: 2 trot).
Unhurried: seconds after a threat, gunfire or fight that it will still sprint.
Jealous: it notices you with another horse within this range (m).
Jealous: chance it calls and stamps when you pat, brush, feed or ride another horse.
Restless: seconds standing still (you on it or near) before it starts fidgeting.
Restless: stomps, snorts and head tosses per minute while it's kept standing.
Trail snob: seconds of walking before a casual ride insults it.
Trail snob: insulted snorts per minute after that.
War horse: an enemy within this range (m) gets attacked while you're off it.
Snob: ears back per minute at a cheaper horse (same stat tier or lower, other breed) within Short king range.
Showboat: people within this range (m) count as a crowd.
Showboat: how many people make a crowd.
Showboat: chance it rears when you stop from a gallop in front of a crowd.
Must lead: a moving horse ahead within this range (m) annoys it.
Must lead: agitated per minute while it has to follow another horse.
Racer: another moving horse within this range (m) is a challenger.
Racer: challenging calls per minute while you ride at pace next to another horse.
Spoiled: seconds of galloping before a stop earns it a treat, in its mind.
Spoiled: chance it calls for a treat when that gallop ends.
Separation anxiety: you this far away (m) from it while it stands counts as leaving.
Separation anxiety: whinnies per minute while you're away.
No brakes: chance of a sideways skid on a hard stop from a gallop.
No brakes: from gallop to under walking pace within this many seconds is a hard stop.
Grudge: after it's hurt under you, pats and brushing get nothing back for this long (a treat forgives it).
Downhill snob: going down faster than this (m/s) at a walk is a steep downhill.
Downhill snob: offended snorts per minute when held to a walk downhill.
Stranger danger: someone hurrying toward you within this range (m).
Stranger danger: walking faster than this (m/s) toward you counts as hurrying.
Stranger danger: how quickly it reacts, per minute, while someone is rushing you.
Needs soothing: seconds after the danger before it starts fretting.
Needs soothing: it frets for up to this long after a danger, unless you pat or calm it.
Needs soothing: frets (call and stamp) per minute.
Hill crawler: the pace cap on a steep climb (move blend ratio: 1 walk), even when spurred.
Water sigh: heavy sighs per minute moving through water.
Apple beggar: you on foot within this range (m) of it.
Apple beggar: seconds you stand there before it starts asking.
Apple beggar: asks per minute after that.
Balker: refusals per minute on a steep climb (Hill climb speed) or in water, however hard you spur.
